notes.title: The demo version of Horrors Glade is already available!
notes.content:
Fans of survival horror got the opportunity to be the first to plunge into the gloomy atmosphere of a mysterious forest in the new demo version of the game Horrors Glade.
What the demo version offers:
• Explore an open world where every shadow can be dangerous
• Basic mechanics of crafting and resource extraction
• The opportunity to get acquainted with the survival and monster fighting system
• Test your skills in fighting hunger and fear

Management:
• WASD for moving
• Q/E for camera rotation
• Tab for inventory and crafting
• Left mouse button to attack and hack

The developers invite everyone to try out the demo version and share their opinion about the project. This is a great opportunity to evaluate the atmosphere and mechanics of the game in advance before the release of the full version.
Don't miss the chance to be the first to test your survival skills in the creepy atmosphere of Horrors Glade!
